Flatten DirectLibMatch results to a data.frame

results_df.Rd

Convert the results slot (a list of per-feature/per-hit lists) from a DirectLibMatch object into a single data.frame. Optionally collapse vector fields Compound_peak_mz_full and Compound_peak_int_full into comma-separated strings, either overwriting the originals or writing to new *_str columns.

Usage

results_df(object, collapse_full = TRUE, remove_full = TRUE, suffix = "_str")

Arguments

object

A DirectLibMatch object with results populated (e.g., after calling libAnnotate()).

collapse_full

Logical; collapse *_full vectors to strings? Default is TRUE.

remove_full

Logical; if TRUE, remove the original *_full columns and write collapsed strings to new columns with suffix. If FALSE, overwrite the original *_full with the collapsed strings. Default is FALSE.

suffix

Character; suffix for new columns when remove_full = TRUE. Default is "_str".

Value

A data.frame with one row per element of object@results.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
obj <- DirectLibMatch(
  FT = result_PA14_FT_filtered,
  compounds_list = PA14_CBIO_library_MS1,
  diff_mz_thr = 0.005, diff_rt_thr = 60, ppm = 10,
  ms_level = "MS1", polarity = "pos", results = list()
)
obj <- libAnnotate(obj)
df  <- results_df(obj)
df2 <- results_df(obj, remove_full = TRUE)
as.data.frame(obj)
} # }
